children: Indaptus Therapeutics entered into an amended and restated at-the-market offering agreement to provide flexible access to equity capital. The program allows sales of up to $100 million of common stock, with H.C. Wainwright acting as sales agent and potentially as principal. Shares may be sold from time to time on the open market or via approved private transactions, with a 3.0% placement fee when Wainwright acts as agent. A related prospectus supplement was filed on August 31, 2026 under the company’s effective Form S-3 shelf.
: Amended and restated at-the-market offering agreement (up to $100,000,000)
: Provide flexible access to equity capital
